title: ScVal address whose ScAddressType (6) is one past the last arm declared at Protocol 30
caps_note: A cross-cutting encoding rule rather than a CAP: it applies to every XDR value of every protocol
why: ScAddressType 5 (muxed contract) is the last arm at Protocol 30; 6 selects nothing. A decoder that accepts it, or reads its body as some other address type, produces an address that does not exist.

source.reason: ScAddressType 6 is one past the highest declared arm at Protocol 30; core's decoder rejects it

notes: Probe vector 6g. The committed core transcript uses ScAddressType 9 ("bad value of type in SCAddress"); stellar-core 30.0.0 print-xdr --filetype scval on these exact bytes (type 6) gives the same error (run by hand for this entry).
